performance_case.causal_mechanism: A forward discovery lane that safely detects a missed capture but cannot autonomously preserve the failed window and start a new untouched one remains permanently stalled unless a person intervenes. A deterministic discovery-only rollover under the existing heartbeat can restore future falsifiability without relabelling backfill as prospective evidence.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive result proves only that temporary offline ResearchStore tests implement a deterministic, restart-safe, discovery-only rollover from MISSED_CAPTURE_WINDOW to one strictly future zero-observation successor with a pre-start DENY-backfill source contract, predecessor closure and existing-heartbeat event. It does not prove deployment, live rollover, future capture continuity, predictive value, strategy value, fees, slippage, PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS or any Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any future path-risk or drawdown benefit remains MISSING_PROOF until the successor accumulates untouched evidence, yields a preregistered mechanism, and later passes separate equal-capital Validation and sealed OOS gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Without the slice, the 90-day discovery lane becomes safely but permanently idle after one missed day and requires user management. The bounded five-file change consumes control-plane engineering time, so it must stop if correctness requires a new schema, queue, timer, writer, source authority or broader recovery framework.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: This capability has zero immediate fee-adjusted PnL effect. Its research value is reducing time lost after an integrity-safe capture miss by resuming one clean discovery clock automatically, while preserving the failed window as evidence and preventing manual repair, duplicate clocks or outcome-driven continuation.
